system_description.narrative_title: Middle East conflict fuels a global fuel & shipping logistics crisis
system_description.narrative_summary: A spike in tanker attacks, threats to Strait of Hormuz access and steady OPEC+ output have strained crude and diesel logistics, prompting G7 releases of emergency stocks and emergency policy moves. Shipping routes are being rerouted (including Arctic passages), inventories remain thin and industry leaders warn rebuilding stockpiles will take years, producing sustained higher fuel costs that ripple into trucking, consumer prices and industrial supply chains. The story ties geopolitics, energy markets and transport logistics into a feedback-driven disruption affecting prices, trade flows and policy responses worldwide.
system_description.scope: Flows of crude and refined fuels (production, exports, tanker movements, inventories), shipping routes and maritime security (Strait of Hormuz, rerouting), OPEC+/producer output decisions, strategic stock releases (G7/IEA), refinery/logistics capacity and fuel distribution (diesel supply to trucking), price formation and consumer/industrial impacts

variables.name: Crude production rate
variables.description: The volumetric rate at which crude oil is extracted and brought to market per unit time across producing regions.

variables.name: Producer output quota
variables.description: The aggregate level of officially signaled or coordinated production targets set by major producing groups or coalitions.

variables.name: Crude export flow
variables.description: The volume-per-time of crude oil shipments leaving producing regions and entering international trade lanes.

variables.name: Refined fuel output
variables.description: The rate at which refineries convert crude into refined products (diesel, gasoline, jet fuel) available for distribution.

variables.name: Refinery utilization rate
variables.description: The proportion of refinery processing capacity currently in operation relative to total installed capacity.

variables.name: Tanker transit capacity
variables.description: The effective throughput capacity of oil tanker movements through maritime routes and chokepoints per unit time.

variables.name: Chokepoint accessibility
variables.description: The degree to which critical maritime passages (e.g., narrow straits) are passable for commercial shipping relative to normal conditions.

variables.name: Maritime security risk
variables.description: The frequency and severity of hostile incidents, attacks, or threats affecting commercial shipping on key sea lanes.

variables.name: Shipping route deviation
variables.description: The average increase in voyage distance or transit time caused by rerouting away from preferred sea lanes.

variables.name: Tanker availability
variables.description: The stock of commercially available tanker tonnage (idle or deployable) ready to transport crude or refined products.

variables.name: Global oil inventories
variables.description: The aggregate volumes of crude and refined product stocks held in commercial storage across markets.

variables.name: Strategic reserve levels
variables.description: The volumes of publicly held emergency petroleum reserves set aside to be released in response to supply shocks.

variables.name: Diesel distribution rate
variables.description: The flow rate at which diesel is moved from refineries and storage into regional wholesale and retail networks (trucking, local depots).

variables.name: Diesel price level
variables.description: The prevailing wholesale or retail price of diesel fuel that reflects market clearing conditions.

variables.name: Shipping freight rates
variables.description: The cost level for chartering and insuring tanker voyages, including freight, insurance, and risk surcharges.

variables.name: Market risk premium
variables.description: The additional price component market participants assign to fuels and freight to compensate for perceived supply disruption risk.

catalysts.title: OPEC+ to hold November quotas steady
catalysts.description: OPEC+ is set to keep November output targets unchanged, limiting official production increases despite supply pressure from the Middle East conflict.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'OPEC+ set to hold November oil quotas steady', 'OPEC+ agrees in principle to keep November oil output targets steady'.

catalysts.title: G7 agreed release of 100 million barrels
catalysts.description: G7 nations plan a coordinated release of about 100 million barrels of diesel and crude via the IEA to relieve tight fuel markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'G-7 Agrees to Release 100 Million Barrels', 'G7 to release 100 million barrels of diesel and other reserves through IEA'.

catalysts.title: Iran reiterates conditions for Hormuz reopening
catalysts.description: Iran's refusal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz unless conditions met keeps the chokepoint at elevated closure risk and sustained restriction potential.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iran says Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until conditions are met', 'More tankers struck in the Middle East'.

catalysts.title: Spike in tanker attacks off Gulf/Oman
catalysts.description: A wave of strikes on tankers (including off Oman) is likely to persist, disrupting voyages and raising insurance and rerouting costs.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'More tankers struck in the Middle East', 'Crude oil tanker struck by unknown projectile off Oman'.

catalysts.title: Saudi cuts November prices to Asia
catalysts.description: Saudi Arabia's unexpected November crude price cuts to Asia will encourage flows to Asian buyers and pressure regional refined fuel prices.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Saudi Arabia unexpectedly cuts November oil prices to Asia to 6-year lows'.

catalysts.title: Multi‑year rebuild of global oil stocks
catalysts.description: Aramco warns replenishing global oil stockpiles could take up to two years, implying a prolonged inventory rebuilding process and drawn-out market effects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Aramco CEO Says Oil Inventories Could Take Two Years to Rebuild', 'Saudi Aramco chief says replenishing global oil stockpiles could take two years'.

catalysts.title: U.S. to expand tax‑exempt diesel access
catalysts.description: A presidential order expanding access to tax‑exempt diesel would ease costs for eligible users and alter domestic diesel distribution patterns.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Trump to issue order expanding access to tax-exempt diesel fuel, sources say'.

catalysts.title: Rising use of Arctic sea routes
catalysts.description: Diversion of tankers to Arctic routes is growing, reducing dependence on Middle Eastern chokepoints while changing voyage distances and costs.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Arctic sea routes boom as Gulf war and global warming divert shipping' (FT).

catalysts.title: Fragile recovery of Middle East exports
catalysts.description: Middle Eastern crude exports have partially recovered to pre‑war levels in parts of September, but the recovery remains fragile due to attacks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Middle East oil exports top pre-war levels for part of September but tanker attacks increase', 'Middle Eastern oil exports rise to highest level since Iran war began'.
